tasks.label: Restart SalesProduct server
args: $listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($listener) { Stop-Process -Id $listener.OwningProcess -Force }; Start-Process -FilePath 'g:\be10x\SalesProduct\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -ArgumentList 'app.py' -WorkingDirectory 'g:\be10x\SalesProduct'
